criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Management: Lost, Stolen, or Damaged Card
categories.definition: Queries about reporting a lost, stolen, or damaged card, freezing it, or requesting a replacement.

categories.name: Card Management: Card Not Working
categories.definition: Queries about a physical or virtual card being declined, stuck in an ATM, or not functioning as expected (e.g., contactless issues).

categories.name: Card Management: Order and Activation
categories.definition: Queries about ordering a new card (physical or virtual), receiving it, activating it, linking it, or issues with card delivery.

categories.name: Card Management: PIN Management
categories.definition: Queries about finding, changing, resetting, or unblocking a card PIN or passcode.

categories.name: Card Management: Virtual Card Features
categories.definition: Queries specifically about the functionality, limits, security, or general information regarding disposable or virtual cards.

categories.name: Card Management: Card Usage and Features
categories.definition: Queries about where and how a card can be used, its capabilities, or general information not covered by other card categories.

categories.name: Transactions: Unauthorized or Fraudulent
categories.definition: Queries about unrecognized transactions, suspected fraud, or charges made without the user's authorization.

categories.name: Transactions: Declined or Failed
categories.definition: Queries about why a transaction (payment, top-up, transfer) was declined or failed.

categories.name: Transactions: Pending Status
categories.definition: Queries about the status of a transaction that is pending, how long it will take, or issues with pending transactions.

categories.name: Transactions: Refunds and Cancellations
categories.definition: Queries about cancelling a purchase, requesting a refund, or issues with a refund not appearing.

categories.name: Transactions: Duplicate Charges
categories.definition: Queries about being charged multiple times for a single transaction.

categories.name: Transfers: Initiating and Receiving Funds
categories.definition: Queries about how to send or receive money, including setting up transfers or direct deposits.

categories.name: Transfers: Issues with Transfers
categories.definition: Queries about transfers not being received by the recipient, delays, or other problems with money transfers.

categories.name: Transfers: Cancelling Transfers
categories.definition: Queries about cancelling a money transfer.

categories.name: Top-up: How to Top-up
categories.definition: Queries about the methods available for adding funds to an account or card, including auto-top-up features.

categories.name: Top-up: Top-up Issues
categories.definition: Queries about problems encountered while trying to top-up, such as denials, missing funds, limits, or verification issues.

categories.name: Fees and Charges: General Inquiry
categories.definition: Queries about unexpected fees, general fee structures, or questions about specific charges for any service.

categories.name: Exchange Rates and Currency Conversion
categories.definition: Queries about current exchange rates, how currency conversion works, or issues with applied exchange rates.

categories.name: Account Management: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Queries about the identity verification process, requirements, or issues encountered during verification.

categories.name: Account Management: Account Details and Settings
categories.definition: Queries about changing personal details, account settings, or general account information.

categories.name: Account Management: Account Closure or Deletion
categories.definition: Queries about closing or deleting an account.

categories.name: Account Management: Eligibility and Requirements
categories.definition: Queries about age requirements, eligibility for services, or general requirements to open or use an account.

categories.name: ATM Issues: Malfunction or Wrong Amount
categories.definition: Queries about ATMs malfunctioning, dispensing the wrong amount of cash, or retaining a card.

categories.name: ATM Issues: Location and Compatibility
categories.definition: Queries about finding ATMs, which ATMs are compatible, or where cash withdrawals are possible.

categories.name: General App or Technical Issues
categories.definition: Queries about problems with the banking app, website, or other technical difficulties not specific to a transaction type.

categories.name: General Information or Support
categories.definition: Broad questions about the bank's services, policies, locations, or general inquiries not fitting into other specific categories.
